metadata.sampling: 6 shoulder-to-TCP radii x 7 elevations x 24 cube orientations; horizontal elevation included whenever its bound interval contains zero; collapsed bounds substitute azimuth samples; exact duplicate poses removed. Tool orientations rotate with azimuth. Collision and joint-stop checks disabled.
metadata.algorithm: one catalog-fit base seed per allowed layout, then seeded bounded mixed search; one candidate evaluation per cycle
metadata.objective: maximize guaranteed sampled-basis payload; arm mass breaks ties; J_G is recorded
metadata.motor_offset_coordinates: Local deltas about approved base placements; coaxial coordinates are fixed
metadata.checks: approved local mounts, zero-pose own-joint assembly clearance and reach required; global collision and mechanical joint-stop checks disabled

retention: No automatic deletion; output snapshots are exclusive writes.
